title: R3. Swept off the map edge, then walks home
looking_at: Colonists stand on moving river water at the map edge where the river leaves. The game keeps a book of who was washed away (pending); after the current carries one off, they are walked home.
check: Within about 1500 ticks at least one colonist should vanish off the edge (the book's pending count rises).
Then they return: pending drops back to 0 and the washed-away colonist is on the map again.
passif: pending rose, returned to 0, and a washed-away colonist is back on the map.
fails: Nobody is carried off in 1500 ticks, or the book empties but nobody is back.
images: Start: colonists standing in the moving water at the map edge
After 250 ticks: whoever the current carried off the edge is gone
After the walk home: the washed-away colonists are back
readings: R3.a: pending 0 -> 3 after 250 ticks (5 colonists staged)
R3.c: washed away ['Human49718', 'Human49724', 'Human49730']; back on the map after return: ['Human49718', 'Human49724', 'Human49730']
R3.d: the 'Swept away' / 'Back from the river' letters are not read by this walk (the river suite's swept chain reads them)
